answer_1.quote: Multi-modal neural machine translation (NMT) has become an important research direction ... it significantly extends the conventional text-based machine translation by taking images as additional inputs ... we conduct extensive experiments on Multi30k datasets of two language pairs ... Experimental results ... indicate that our encoder is effective to fuse multi-modal information for NMT.

answer_2.quote: We use the metrics BLEU and METEOR (Denkowski and Lavie, 2014) to evaluate the quality of translations.
